preconditions.description: The number of rooms n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 10**6 for x, y, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y, v) must have room indices x and y between 1 and n, and tunnel time v between 1 and 1,000,000.
The input must contain exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**11 for l in l_values)
preconditions.description: Each query value l must be between 1 and 10^11 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, one for each query value of l.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a valid integer representing the maximum number of children for the corresponding l.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= n for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The maximum number of children for each l must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) >= int(output_lines[j]) if l_values[i] >= l_values[j] else True for i in range(q) for j in range(q))
postconditions.description: The maximum number of children must be non-increasing as l increases (monotonicity).
For each l, there must exist a connected subtree of rooms where the difference between the maximum and minimum farthest path to the ground is ≤ l.

postconditions.expression: all(max_children(l) == int(output_lines[i]) for i, l in enumerate(l_values))
postconditions.description: The output for each l must equal the maximum number of children that can be placed in a connected subtree such that the difference between the farthest paths to the ground is ≤ l.
